steps.title: Direct impact
steps.description: Crude oil rises 30% — jet fuel and refining input costs surge across all airlines & refiners.

steps.title: 2nd-order effect
steps.description: IndiGo & SpiceJet operating margins compress by 180 to 260 bps.

steps.title: 3rd-order effect
steps.description: Airlines pass fuel costs on — average airfares increase 8% to 12%.

steps.title: 4th-order endpoint
steps.description: Domestic leisure travel demand softens 6%, causing secondary occupancy drag on hotel chains (Indian Hotels, Lemon Tree).

steps.title: Direct impact
steps.description: Lending benchmark rates fall — bank borrowing costs ease immediately.

steps.title: 2nd-order effect
steps.description: Retail home loan and auto loan credit demand expands by 14–18%.

steps.title: 3rd-order endpoint
steps.description: Automotive OEMs (Tata Motors, Maruti) and real estate developers experience surge in pre-sales.
